page.overview:
Who is Kiriya Ubuyashiki?

Kiriya is a boy with light, pale skin and large, purple eyes. He initially had the same hairstyle as the rest of his siblings; a blunt bob with a fringe covering his eyebrows, colored black. As he was raised as a girl, he takes on a more feminine appearance during his first appearance, including having pronounced eyelashes and red lips.

During Final Selection, Kiriya wore a purple uchikake kimono with patterned flowers and a green obi, supported with a white obiage and indigo obijime along with a white juban under everything. His head is adorned with a wisteria headpiece.

After Kiriya becomes the leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, he stops dressing like a girl and removes any feminine features, such as his makeup and his wisteria headpiece. He instead wears a black kimono with a long white haori that is reminiscent of his father. He also parts the fringe on his hair, adopting a hair style akin to his ancestors.

More than a hundred years after the disbandment of the Corps, Kiriya is still alive in the present day as the oldest living person in Japan. He wears the same clothing he wore after succeeding his father, although he is shown to have grown bald with only a few strands of hair, gained heavy wrinkles, and is very diminutive.
